variants.name: 今日动一动
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality Chinese iPhone fitness-tab UI for the existing app 小食痰记. This is a NEW FITNESS SCREEN WITHIN THE SAME APP, NOT a website and not a new app brand.
Target dimensions: exactly a 390 x 844 logical-pixel viewport, rendered crisply at 3x (1170 x 2532 preferred). A single complete mobile app content screen fills the portrait canvas. No device bezel, no phone body, no notch, no Dynamic Island, no OS status bar, clock, signal, battery, no home indicator, no browser chrome, no rounded device mask, no device shadow. Do not place multiple screens or ideas in one image. Preserve natural mobile proportions; do not stretch or squash the layout.

Attached reference image 1 is the ACTUAL existing diary screen; image 2 is the ACTUAL profile screen. These define the app's visual language, typography, cream canvas, sunny yellow, warm brown, rounded surfaces, and native translucent pill navigation. Use only the product content style; do not reproduce their iOS status bars. Image 3 is the ORIGINAL FIXED full-body milk-frog character. Image 4 is the ORIGINAL FIXED FACE. These are character identity references, not optional inspiration. Preserve this exact character: YELLOW pear-shaped soft chubby body, narrow rounded head merging with body, protruding pale-green eye surrounds and BLACK pupils, tiny deadpan horizontal mouth, lighter yellow belly, very long floppy arms, short legs and broad feet. Ugly-cute deadpan mischievous milk-frog, believable softly lit 3D clay/rubber texture like the original. Do not turn it into a green frog, change its face, add a snout, hair, eyebrows, huge smile or muscles, dress it as a different character, or make an anime mascot. Change only pose/action and permitted simple fitness props. It must feel like the original character newly posed, not a new character. Avoid always-standing poses.

Hard brand tokens: warm cream #FFF9E9 main background, sunny yellow #FFCA24 and soft #FFDE4A, warm white #FFFCF2 content surfaces, dark warm brown #2E261A text and CTAs, muted brown #7A6E52 secondary text, very restrained olive #668221. SF Pro/PingFang Chinese typography with rounded bold prominent numbers; 14–16 logical px for body. Existing product large rounded yellow hero and warm-white grouped content can be reused but keep hierarchy restrained. Use spacing/grouping, then separators, subtle surface tints, borders only when needed and restrained soft shadows. No nested card stacks, no visually busy dashboard of dozens of metrics. Skeuomorphic mini equipment icons should be actual detailed 3D gym objects similar in finish to the reference's food and shoe icons, not emoji.

Single screen focus: a useful, welcoming, noncompetitive fitness log for ordinary people. It consumes existing strength/cardio records, user-created reusable plans and read-only Apple Health workouts. The overall fitness tab goes AFTER 趋势. Bottom native liquid-glass-like floating pill navigation with five evenly spaced icon + text items EXACTLY: 饮食 | 趋势 | 健身 | 戒烟 | 我的. 健身 is selected, warm yellow translucent capsule, a dumbbell icon. Warm-brown simple native glyphs. Avoid a black cigarette icon glamour shot; use existing lung-style 戒烟 glyph. Clear fixed primary action above the tab bar, with enough bottom breathing room and no overlaps. This screen assumes user enabled smoking tracking; no menstrual tracking entry on this view. No subscription, payment, body leaderboard, streak punishment, generated complex plan, camera motion recognition, or unsupported health diagnosis. Clearly readable concise Chinese labels and exact numerals; no lorem ipsum. All mock statistics are illustrative and should be identified in small text '示例数据'. Current date anchor is Thursday 2026-11-05. Any visible week must be Mon Nov 2, Tue 3, Wed 4, Thu 5 (today), Fri 6, Sat 7, Sun 8, with future dates muted. Do not show impossible future workout records.

Create a focused primary screen, not a feature inventory. One clear primary action, only a couple of supporting content areas. Preserve current visual style while changing hierarchy for the stated concept.

Concept name (for internal art direction only, do not print this phrase): 今日动一动.
Layout: at top left bold '健身', below '11月5日 星期四'; small top-right '示例数据' and simple calendar affordance. Main large sunny yellow rounded hero occupying roughly the upper third: left small capsule '今日运动', huge '42' with unit '分钟', smaller line '训练消耗 286 千卡' and tiny source '来自 Apple 健康'. On the right pose the original milk-frog SEATED on a low tiny gym bench doing a comically effortful light dumbbell curl with long floppy arms, one small sweat bead, face still the unchanged deadpan tiny horizontal mouth. Realistic 3D cutout integrated on yellow, not an illustration of a green frog. Small cream speech bubble '动一点，也算数。'. Within the bottom of the same hero a calm horizontal strip '本周训练 3 次' and '累计 126 分钟', not circular activity rings.

Below hero a clear heading '常用计划' with small '全部 ›'. One grouped warm-white row with a realistic mini dumbbell prop on the left, title '全身力量 A', subline '5 个动作 · 约 45 分钟', small trailing play glyph. Beneath it one slim warm cream advice row with small original frog face peek, title '奶蛙小建议', readable copy '今天已完成训练，晚餐记得搭配蛋白质。', fine muted evidence '根据今日训练与饮食记录'. No fixed gram recommendation, no invented recovery score. At bottom dominant wide warm-dark-brown pill CTA '+ 记录训练'. Then the five-tab liquid-glass pill navigation. All content fits within the 844 logical-pixel canvas with generous margins, legible text, no clipping and no cartoon wallpaper. Render the mascot new SEATED CURL pose faithfully from the original references.

Concept name (internal art direction only): 训练搭子.
Different information hierarchy from a metrics-led dashboard: user-created reusable workout plans are central, designed for people preparing to train. The main action starts recording an existing plan; do NOT claim AI generated this plan. At top bold '健身', subtitle '11月5日 星期四'; tiny '示例数据' and a calendar icon on right. A relatively shallow sunny-yellow welcome region: left friendly title '今天，练点什么？', smaller '按自己的节奏来。'; right original yellow milk-frog doing a SEATED FLOOR HAMSTRING STRETCH on a small olive mat, one broad foot extended and both long hands reaching the toes, softly pudgy original body, unchanged deadpan face. No heroic muscular human body. Cream speech bubble '先拉伸，再开练。'. Keep the mascot fresh and identity-faithful.

Below a roomy heading row '我的计划' and small '管理 ›'. Main warm-white grouped training-plan surface (the dominant content) with small olive label '力量训练', large title '全身力量 A', readable secondary '5 个动作 · 约 45 分钟'. Three flat separator rows with believable small 3D gym object icons and correct text: '高脚杯深蹲' / '3 组 × 12 次'; '哑铃卧推' / '3 组 × 10 次'; '坐姿划船' / '3 组 × 12 次'. Tiny text '另有 2 个动作'. Avoid fake plan-generation labels. Under the plan, a modest flat horizontal weekly summary '本周已练 2 次 · 累计 84 分钟'. A single compact AI advice line headed '奶蛙提醒' with exact copy '上一场力量训练在周一，今天可以按原计划记录。' and fine source '根据最近训练记录'. This is a mock scenario with Monday Nov 2 and Wednesday Nov 4 as prior workouts, today Nov 5 not yet trained. No body-weight goals or unconfirmed gender/age assumptions.

Bottom dominant wide dark-brown pill CTA '开始这次训练' with a simple play glyph; small inline adjacent-to-section alternative '自由记录 ›' somewhere natural above main CTA, not another giant button. Then the exact five-tab native translucent pill nav with 健身 selected. Focus on comfortable readability, well spaced content, warm cream and yellow, different composition from a stats hero. All fits 390 x 844 with no overlap. Minimal elevation and one cohesive plan surface, no card-in-card. Full fidelity Chinese text, fixed face, new SEATED STRETCHING mascot action.

Concept name (internal art direction only): 运动手账.
Different information hierarchy: a compact weekly overview and a readable chronological workout journal, emphasizing reflection over a current-session dashboard or long workout-plan menu. This is still the FITNESS HOME TAB, not the Trends tab. Top left bold '健身' and subtitle '11月5日 星期四'; top-right small '示例数据' and history/calendar glyph.
Main sunny-yellow rounded header region approximately 270 logical pixels tall. Left title '本周，慢慢来。', below huge '3' and smaller '次训练', with '累计 126 分钟' below. Right the ORIGINAL yellow milk-frog lying on its back on an olive exercise mat after training, knees bent and broad feet raised casually, a little cream towel on its forehead, long arms resting over pale belly; unchanged narrow rounded head, green eye surrounds, black pupils and tiny straight deadpan mouth. A tiny water bottle is next to the mat, no other competing illustrations. Speech bubble '歇会儿，也算正事。'. This is humorous warm recovery, NOT an exhausted or sick new character. Below this within the same yellow surface a seven-day horizontal week strip correctly reading weekday first row '一 二 三 四 五 六 日' and date second row '2 3 4 5 6 7 8'. Days 2, 4, 5 show tasteful filled small olive/yellow completion markers. Thu 5 is selected as today with small label '今天'. Nov 6,7,8 are muted FUTURE dates with no completion. No extra chart or gratuitous streak.

Below hero a flat section title '最近训练', small '全部 ›'. One warm-white GROUPED JOURNAL list surface with two separator-divided rows, each using realistic 3D equipment objects and clear source attribution:
First row a detailed cream running-shoe icon, title '户外跑步', tiny '今天 18:30', strong readable '42 分钟 · 5.2 公里', small muted source 'Apple 健康', trailing subtle chevron.
Second row a detailed dumbbell icon, title '全身力量 A', tiny '昨天 19:10', strong '40 分钟 · 5 个动作', small muted source '手动记录', trailing chevron.
No double-counted duplicate training. This is a mock late-evening snapshot; today after 18:30 and last week sessions Nov2 44min, Nov4 40min, Nov5 42min together equal126min.
A calm short olive-tinted advice line/surface below with tiny frog-face peek and title '奶蛙陪你看变化', exact body '这周记录了 3 次训练，下一次按身体感受安排。', fine '根据近 7 天训练记录'. Avoid medical recovery score, never say someone is recovered or cleared for intense exercise. Keep the typography readable rather than cramming.

Bottom wide dominant warm-dark-brown pill '+ 记录训练'. Exact five-item liquid-glass pill nav with 健身 selected. A realistic cohesive iOS app screen, not a collage or poster, no device/OS decorations. Warm cream breathing room, readably large Chinese, generous grouping, actual skeuomorphic shoe/dumbbell objects, mascot new LYING RECOVERY pose while preserving the original external appearance exactly. Show the weekly mini calendar and 2-row journal as the only supporting content areas, with a compact advice line. Fit completely in 390 x 844 logical pixels.
